Fancy Text Generator

Turn plain text into 24 stylish Unicode fonts and emoji styles — bold, italic, script, fraktur, monospace, circled, upside-down, sparkle-wrapped, emoji-framed and more — with one-tap copy on each style.

Click any style to copy it. Some rare styles may not render on very old devices.

📖 How to use

  1. Type your text in the input box.
  2. Browse the 24 generated styles.
  3. Click a style to copy it instantly.
  4. Paste it into your bio, post or comment.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I copy a fancy style?

Type your text and every style updates live below it. Click any style (or its Copy button) to copy it to your clipboard.

Will these fonts work on Instagram and TikTok?

They are Unicode characters, so they work on Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X and most other platforms and phones.

Why does a style show as boxes on my phone?

Some very old devices or apps may not render rare Unicode blocks like fraktur or double-struck. Bold and italic work almost everywhere.
